applicableAreas: Cover sheet project information section - zoning designation area
findings.comment: Zoning designation (MF-2) and case number (C14-2011-0093) are shown, but specific ordinance numbers governing the zoning designation are not referenced. Applicable zoning ordinance numbers must be included per UCM 2.5.1(E).

applicableAreas: Cover sheet project information section - zoning conditions area
findings.comment: Site is subject to LDC Subchapter F (Residential Design Standards) compatibility requirements due to adjacent SF-3 zoning, including maximum 2-story / 30-foot height limit within 25 feet of SF-3 lot line and step-up schedule beyond. These zoning conditions and restrictions are not noted on the cover sheet as required.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet Site Development Data table - project team contact information
findings.comment: Project team contact information on the Site Development Data table includes Owner, Engineer, Architect, and Landscape Architect, but Surveyor company name, address, and telephone number are not provided. Surveyor contact information must be included per UCM 2.5.1(E).

No dedicated section listing required legal instruments (restrictive covenants, maintenance agreements, easements, license agreements, subdivision recordation, or deferral agreements) is present on the cover sheet. All applicable legal instruments must be listed with their recording information per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Site includes a privately maintained detention/biofiltration pond for stormwater management. The cover sheet notes general maintenance requirements but does not reference a recorded maintenance agreement document number. Once the maintenance agreement is formally recorded, the document number must be added to the cover sheet.

Legal description shows the subdivision volume and page (Volume 73, Page 76, Mecey Subdivision), but the instrument or document recording number is not included. Complete final plat recording information including document/instrument number must be referenced per UCM 2.5.1.E.13.
